law.catch_line: Hampton Roads and Eastern Shore Agricultural Research and Extension Centers established
law.text: The Hampton Roads and Eastern Shore Agricultural Research and Extension Centers (Centers) are established as a component of the Station and shall be retained as active research and extension centers.
